verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.pt: Passados dois anos inteiros, Faraó sonhou que estava em pé junto ao rio Nilo;
verses.en_web: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed: and behold, he stood by the river.
verses.en_bbe: Now after two years had gone by, Pharaoh had a dream; and in his dream he was by the side of the Nile;

verses.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
verses.pt: e eis que subiam do rio sete vacas, formosas à vista e gordas de carne, e pastavam no carriçal.
verses.en_web: Behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
verses.en_bbe: And out of the Nile came seven cows, good-looking and fat, and their food was the river-grass.

verses.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.pt: Após elas subiam do rio outras sete vacas, feias à vista e magras de carne; e paravam junto às outras vacas à beira do Nilo.
verses.en_web: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.
verses.en_bbe: And after them seven other cows came out of the Nile, poor-looking and thin; and they were by the side of the other cows.

verses.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.pt: E as vacas feias à vista e magras de carne devoravam as sete formosas à vista e gordas. Então Faraó acordou.
verses.en_web: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.en_bbe: And the seven thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows. Then Pharaoh came out of his sleep.

verses.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.pt: Depois dormiu e tornou a sonhar; e eis que brotavam dum mesmo pé sete espigas cheias e boas.
verses.en_web: He slept and dreamed a second time: and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
verses.en_bbe: But he went to sleep again and had a second dream, in which he saw seven heads of grain, full and good, all on one stem.

verses.en: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
verses.pt: Após elas brotavam sete espigas miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental;
verses.en_web: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.en_bbe: And after them came up seven other heads, thin and wasted by the east wind.

verses.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.pt: e as espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas grandes e cheias. Então Faraó acordou, e eis que era um sonho.
verses.en_web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
verses.en_bbe: And the seven thin heads made a meal of the good heads. And when Pharaoh was awake he saw it was a dream.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.pt: Pela manhã o seu espírito estava perturbado; pelo que mandou chamar todos os adivinhadores do Egito, e todos os seus sábios; e Faraó contou-lhes os seus sonhos, mas não havia quem lhos interpretasse.
verses.en_web: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: And in the morning his spirit was troubled; and he sent for all the wise men of Egypt and all the holy men, and put his dream before them, but no one was able to give him the sense of it.

verses.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.pt: Então falou o copeiro-mor a Faraó, dizendo: Dos meus pecados me lembro hoje:
verses.en_web: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
verses.en_bbe: Then the chief wine-servant said to Pharaoh, The memory of my sin comes back to me now;

verses.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:
verses.pt: Estando faraó mui indignado contra os seus servos, e pondo-me sob prisão na casa do captão da guarda, a mim e ao padeiro-mor.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.
verses.en_bbe: Pharaoh had been angry with his servants, and had put me in prison in the house of the captain of the army, together with the chief bread-maker;

verses.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.pt: Então sonhamos um sonho na mesma noite, eu e ele, cada um conforme a interpretação do seu sonho sonhamos.
verses.en_web: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. We dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.en_bbe: And we had a dream on the same night, the two of us, and the dreams had a special sense.

verses.en: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.pt: Ora, estava ali conosco um mancebo hbreu, servo do capitão da guarda, ao qual contamos os nossos sonhos, e ele no-los interpretou, a cada um conforme o seu sonho.
verses.en_web: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. To each man according to his dream he interpreted.
verses.en_bbe: And there was with us a young Hebrew, the captain's servant, and when we put our dreams before him, he gave us the sense of them.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
verses.pt: E como ele nos interpretou, assim mesmo foi feito: a mim me fez tornar ao meu estado, e a ele fez enforcar.
verses.en_web: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
verses.en_bbe: And it came about as he said: I was put back in my place, and the bread-maker was put to death by hanging.

verses.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
verses.pt: Então enviou Faraó, e chamou a José, e o fizeram sair logo da cova; e barbeou-se e mudou os seus vestidos, e veio a Faraó.
verses.en_web: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and they took him quickly out of prison; and when his hair had been cut and his dress changed, he came before Pharaoh.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
verses.pt: E Faraó disse a José: Eu sonhei um sonho, e ninguém há que o interprete; mas de ri ouvi dizer que quando ouves um sonho o interpretas.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have had a dream, and no one is able to give me the sense of it; now it has come to my ears that you are able to give the sense of a dream when it is put before you.

verses.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.pt: E respondeu José a Faraó, dizendo: Isso não está em mim; Deus dará resposta de paz a Faraó.
verses.en_web: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph said, Without God there will be no answer of peace for Pharaoh.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
verses.pt: Então disse Faraó a José: Eis que em meu sonho estava em pé na praia do rio,
verses.en_web: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river:
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh said, In my dream I was by the side of the Nile:

verses.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verses.pt: E eis que subiam do rio sete vacas gordas de carne e formosas à vista, e pastavam no prado.
verses.en_web: and behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, fat and sleek. They fed in the marsh grass,
verses.en_bbe: And out of the Nile came seven cows, fat and good-looking, and their food was the river-grass;

verses.en: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.pt: E eis que outras sete vacas subiam após estas, muito feias à vista, e magras de carne; não tenho visto outras taus, quanto à fealdade, em toda a terra do Egito
verses.en_web: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.
verses.en_bbe: Then after them came seven other cows, very thin and poor-looking, worse than any I ever saw in the land of Egypt;

verses.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.pt: E as vacas magras e feias comiam as primeiras sete vacas gordas;
verses.en_web: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle,
verses.en_bbe: And the thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows who came up first;

verses.en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.pt: E entravam em suas entranhas, mas não se conhecia que houvessem entrado em suas entranhas; porque o seu parecer era feio como no principio. Então acordei.
verses.en_web: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.en_bbe: And even with the fat cows inside them they seemed as bad as before. And so I came out of my sleep.

verses.en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
verses.pt: Depois vi em meu sonho, e eis que dum mesmo pé subiam sete espigas cheias e boas;
verses.en_web: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good:
verses.en_bbe: And again in a dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, coming up on one stem:

verses.en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.pt: E eis que sete espigas secas, miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental brotavam após elas.
verses.en_web: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.en_bbe: And then I saw seven other heads, dry, thin, and wasted by the east wind, coming up after them:

verses.en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.pt: E as sete espigas miudas devoravam as sete espigas boas. E eu disse-o aos magos, mas ninguém houve que mo interpretasse.
verses.en_web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
verses.en_bbe: And the seven thin heads made a meal of the seven good heads; and I put this dream before the wise men, but not one of them was able to give me the sense of it.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.pt: Então disse José a Faraó: O sonho de Faraó é um só; o que Deus há de fazer, notificou-o a Faraó.
verses.en_web: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph said, These two dreams have the same sense: God has made clear to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.pt: As sete vacas formosas são sete anos; as sete espigas formosas também são sete anos; o sonho é um só.
verses.en_web: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
verses.en_bbe: The seven fat cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years: the two have the same sense.

verses.en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.pt: E as sete vacas magras e feias à vista, que subiam depois delas, são sete anos, como as sete espigas miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental; serão sete anos de fome.
verses.en_web: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.
verses.en_bbe: The seven thin and poor-looking cows who came up after them are seven years; and the seven heads of grain, dry and wasted by the east wind, are seven years when there will be no food.

verses.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
verses.pt: Esta é a palavra que tenho dito a Faraó; o que Deus há de fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.
verses.en_web: That is the thing which I spoke to Pharaoh. What God is about to do he has shown to Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: As I said to Pharaoh before, God has made clear to him what he is about to do.

verses.en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.pt: E eis que vêm sete anos, e haverá grande fartura em toda a terra do Egito
verses.en_web: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Seven years are coming in which there will be great wealth of grain in Egypt;

verses.en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.pt: E depois deles levantar-se-ão sete anos de fome, e toda aquela fartura será esquecida na terra do Egito, e a fome consumirá a terra:
verses.en_web: There will arise after them seven years of famine, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
verses.en_bbe: And after that will come seven years when there will not be enough food; and the memory of the good years will go from men's minds; and the land will be made waste by the bad years;

verses.en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.pt: e não será conhecida a abundância na terra, por causa daquela fome que seguirá; porquanto será gravíssima.
verses.en_web: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
verses.en_bbe: And men will have no memory of the good time because of the need which will come after, for it will be very bitter.

verses.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.pt: Ora, se o sonho foi duplicado a Faraó, é porque esta coisa é determinada por Deus, e ele brevemente a fará.
verses.en_web: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.en_bbe: And this dream came to Pharaoh twice, because this thing is certain, and God will quickly make it come about.

verses.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Portanto, proveja-se agora Faraó de um homem entendido e sábio, e o ponha sobre a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And now let Pharaoh make search for a man of wisdom and good sense, and put him in authority over the land of Egypt.

verses.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.pt: Faça isto Faraó: nomeie administradores sobre a terra, que tomem a quinta parte dos produtos da terra do Egito nos sete anos de fartura;
verses.en_web: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
verses.en_bbe: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him put overseers over the land of Egypt to put in store a fifth part of the produce of the land in the good years.

verses.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.pt: e ajuntem eles todo o mantimento destes bons anos que vêm, e amontoem trigo debaixo da mão de Faraó, para mantimento nas cidades e o guardem;
verses.en_web: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
verses.en_bbe: And let them get together all the food in those good years and make a store of grain under Pharaoh's control for the use of the towns, and let them keep it.

verses.en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.pt: assim será o mantimento para provimento da terra, para os sete anos de fome, que haverá na terra do Egito; para que a terra não pereça de fome.
verses.en_web: The food will be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; that the land not perish through the famine.”
verses.en_bbe: And let that food be kept in store for the land till the seven bad years which are to come in Egypt; so that the land may not come to destruction through need of food.

verses.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.pt: Esse parecer foi bom aos olhos de Faraó, e aos olhos de todos os seus servos.
verses.en_web: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.en_bbe: And this seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his servants.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
verses.pt: Perguntou, pois, Faraó a seus servos: Poderíamos achar um homem como este, em quem haja o espírito de Deus?
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh said to his servants, Where may we get such a man as this, a man in whom is the spirit of God?

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
verses.pt: Depois disse Faraó a José: Porquanto Deus te fez saber tudo isto, ninguém há tão entendido e sábio como tu.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Seeing that God has made all this clear to you, there is no other man of such wisdom and good sense as you:

verses.en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.pt: Tu estarás sobre a minha casa, e por tua voz se governará todo o meu povo; somente no trono eu serei maior que tu.
verses.en_web: You shall be over my house, and according to your word will all my people be ruled. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”
verses.en_bbe: You, then, are to be over my house, and all my people will be ruled by your word: only as king will I be greater than you.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Disse mais Faraó a José: Vê, eu te hei posto sobre toda a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have put you over all the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.pt: E Faraó tirou da mão o seu anel-sinete e pô-lo na mão de José, vestiu-o de traje de linho fino, e lhe pôs ao pescoço um colar de ouro.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck,
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on Joseph's hand, and he had him clothed with the best linen, and put a chain of gold round his neck;

verses.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Ademais, fê-lo subir ao seu segundo carro, e clamavam diante dele: Ajoelhai-vos. Assim Faraó o constituiu sobre toda a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And he made him take his seat in the second of his carriages; and they went before him crying, Make way! So he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Ainda disse Faraó a José: Eu sou Faraó; sem ti, pois, ninguém levantará a mão ou o pé em toda a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh; and without your order no man may do anything in all the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Faraó chamou a José Zafnate-Paneã, e deu-lhe por mulher Asenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om. Depois saiu José por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh gave Joseph the name of Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, the priest of On, to be his wife. So Joseph went through all the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Ora, José era da idade de trinta anos, quando se apresentou a Faraó, rei do Egito. E saiu José da presença de Faraó e passou por toda a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he came before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from before the face of Pharaoh and went through all the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.pt: Durante os sete anos de fartura a terra produziu a mancheias;
verses.en_web: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
verses.en_bbe: Now in the seven good years the earth gave fruit in masses.

verses.en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.pt: e José ajuntou todo o mantimento dos sete anos, que houve na terra do Egito, e o guardou nas cidades; o mantimento do campo que estava ao redor de cada cidade, guardou-o dentro da mesma.
verses.en_web: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was around every city, he laid up in the same.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph got together all the food of those seven years, and made a store of food in the towns: the produce of the fields round every town was stored up in the town.

verses.en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
verses.pt: Assim José ajuntou muitíssimo trigo, como a areia do mar, até que cessou de contar; porque não se podia mais contá-lo.
verses.en_web: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
verses.en_bbe: So he got together a store of grain like the sand of the sea; so great a store that after a time he gave up measuring it, for it might not be measured.

verses.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.pt: Antes que viesse o ano da fome, nasceram a José dois filhos, que lhe deu Asenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.
verses.en_web: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
verses.en_bbe: And before the time of need, Joseph had two sons, to whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, gave birth.

verses.en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
verses.pt: E chamou José ao primogênito Manassés; porque disse: Deus me fez esquecer de todo o meu trabalho, e de toda a casa de meu pai.
verses.en_web: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
verses.en_bbe: And to the first he gave the name Manasseh, for he said, God has taken away from me all memory of my hard life and of my father's house.

verses.en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.pt: Ao segundo chamou Efraim; porque disse: Deus me fez crescer na terra da minha aflição.
verses.en_web: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
verses.en_bbe: And to the second he gave the name Ephraim, for he said, God has given me fruit in the land of my sorrow.

verses.en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.pt: Acabaram-se, então, os sete anos de fartura que houve na terra do Egito;
verses.en_web: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
verses.en_bbe: And so the seven good years in Egypt came to an end.

verses.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.pt: e começaram a vir os sete anos de fome, como José tinha dito; e havia fome em todas as terras; porém, em toda a terra do Egito havia pão.
verses.en_web: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.en_bbe: Then came the first of the seven years of need as Joseph had said: and in every other land they were short of food; but in the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.pt: Depois toda a terra do Egito teve fome, e o povo clamou a Faraó por pão; e Faraó disse a todos os egípcios: Ide a José; o que ele vos disser, fazei.
verses.en_web: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
verses.en_bbe: And when all the land of Egypt was in need of food, the people came crying to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said to the people, Go to Joseph, and whatever he says to you, do it.

verses.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: De modo que, havendo fome sobre toda a terra, abriu José todos os depósitos, e vendia aos egípcios; porque a fome prevaleceu na terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And everywhere on the earth they were short of food; then Joseph, opening all his store-houses, gave the people of Egypt grain for money; so great was the need of food in the land of Egypt.

verses.en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
verses.pt: Também de todas as terras vinham ao Egito, para comprarem de José; porquanto a fome prevaleceu em todas as terras.
verses.en_web: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And all lands sent to Egypt, to Joseph, to get grain, for the need was great over all the earth.
